purpose: fit independent platform models; no formal/holdout/capacity PPA as training

label_definitions.combinational_delay: launch-Q to capture-D arrival difference; unconditional data boundary flops; clock/clkQ/setup excluded
label_definitions.combinational_area: sum unique nonsequential Liberty master area in isolated sample scope; boundary flops/clock/physical cells separate
label_definitions.grt: same database/stage, global routing estimates; physical overhead unassigned to a sample remains separate
label_definitions.state: separate reset/enable/shared-valid/clock fixtures, no repeated boundary charge per arithmetic node

split_unit: complete source topology and mapped-source equivalence group, including every ABC/SDC target variant; whole multi-sample bundles remain together
independent_test_policy: v1 fanout4 tests sealed and excluded from revision fitting/validation/new test; new fanout6 complete bundles predeclared before revised fitting; evaluation once after selection freeze

algorithms.name: relative_weighted_ridge
algorithms.sample_weight: inverse squared max(abs(label), declared floor), normalized to training row count

selection: validation quality gates first, then normalized MAE, p95 relative error, portable size; if no validation-ready algorithm do not consume independent test for that scope

quality_gates_frozen_before_test.positive_label_floor: max(1ps, reference_platform_period*0.001) for delay; 1e-4um2 for area

margin: positive validation underprediction p95 plus unit-resolution floor; measured heldout coverage reported, no statistical/signoff guarantee
prediction: portable numeric coefficients or bounded tree; identical C++/Python features; no Python or EDA in compilation
support_domain: explicit operation/template/semantics plus validated width/result/fanout and joint ABC/SDC condition; no nearest-table or independent-minmax rectangle fallback
wide_capacity: declare platform/family/width/stage envelope and stretched reference clock before execution; preserve original failure; a capacity diagnostic cannot silently become a training or target label
GF180_gate: wire RC calibration unresolved until independent bounded evidence closes it; original diagnostic probes are not training clearance
main_matrix: not authorized by this protocol; 688 records remain step8
resource_policy: one shared append-only ledger; actual phase list and bounded support, capacity and storage estimates before collection
supersedes: arithmetic-model-characterization-v4; failed first independent tests retained, never training/validation for revision
feature_revision_reason: full vs truncated multiplier area depends on retained product geometry; add max-input-width times result-width and count of retained partial-product bit positions; no post-mapping features
fanout_domain_after_test: 1..6 only after validation and new independent test pass; fanout6 is explicit measured extrapolation beyond training maximum5, not assumed arbitrary extrapolation
